name: Fácánoskert-lakópark

name: Levendulakert

name: Boglárka apartmanpark
note: The municipal ITS explicitly labels Boglárka apartmanpark on the eastern lakeside. Development-phase and parcel extents remain approximate.

name: Remeteség
note: The municipality recognizes Remeteség as a separate quarter and lists its residential street network.
